description: Use this when someone is planning an evening or event with games: game night, house party, birthday, family night, kids, a couple, an office or team event, or friends in different cities. Builds an ordered PadConsole playlist (warm-up, main games, finale) that fits the group size, the occasion and the time available, with links. Does not start a game.

kids.description: True if young children are playing; keeps the plan to games rated age 7 or lower.

locale.description: Language the user is writing in: tr (Turkish), de (German), es (Spanish), id (Indonesian) or en (everything else). Default en.

minutes.description: How long they want to play. Default 90.

occasion.description: friends, family, kids, couple, birthday, office, remote (players in different homes) or solo. Default friends.

remote.description: True if some players are in a different home.

name: plan_game_night
title: Plan a game night
